approved.description: All required readiness dimensions are verified.

provisional.description: Source and contract are usable, but one or more parity dimensions remain unverified.

blocked.description: Source or contract is unavailable, or an explicit blocking issue exists.

acceptedRiskHandling.note: Explicitly user-accepted visual, contrast, or interaction tradeoffs remain internal evidence and do not prevent Fast Preview component selection.

generationGate.styleChecks: visual comparison on request; source boundaries always checked
generationGate.tokenChecks: canonical CSS usage validated before generation
generationGate.note: Fast Preview permits provisional components. Release still requires the levels.allowedStages policy and evidence; generation does not promote maturity.
